messages.subject: Re: problems using src_sqlite
parts:
Hi Cyrus,

Could you please send a reproducible example? This definitely
shouldn't happen, but I have no idea what's going wrong.

Hadley

On Fri, Sep 27, 2013 at 1:31 AM, Cyrus Mohammadian <cmoh...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Im trying to use the dply package to parse out the GDELT data. I was able to
> successfully do so and to replicate it twice in that same sitting. I decided
> to go through the process again a day later and now I keep receiving this
> error after using the src_sqlite function
>
>> gdelt.db <- src_sqlite("/Users/cyrusmohammadian/geldt.db")
>
> Error in src_sqlite("/Users/cyrusmohammadian/geldt.db") :
> lazy-load database 'P' is corrupt
> In addition: Warning message:
> In src_sqlite("/Users/cyrusmohammadian/geldt.db") :
> internal error -3 in R_decompress1
>
> I've gone through it now maybe 8 or 9 times and each time i get the exact
> same error (and I'm not simply copy pasting). Does anyone have any ideas as
> to what the problem could be? The dataset was originally made into a sqlite
> database (.db) using sqlite3 import function.
>
> Thanks in advance for any help
